rationale: The agent verified the user correctly using full name and zip, reviewed the user’s orders, identified the correct IPX7 earbud, selected the cheapest alternative (IPX4, item 1646531091), and the refund amount and details were accurate. However, the agent executed the exchange write immediately after the user’s selection without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation, which the policy requires before any order-changing action. This missing confirmation step constitutes a policy violation, so despite otherwise correct actions and information, the interaction fails the pass bar.
